title: 学校であった怖い話S
title_romaji: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi S

layouts.notes: The stretch being shown is copied to 0x80061858 as 16-bit cells, and the u32 at 0x80060D18 counts the cells typed so far: the message is what is on screen and grows as it types. 0xFF01 ends a page, 0xFF02 is a wait inside a row, 0xFF03 an automatic wrap (13 characters a column); 0xFF04 is not known. The u32 at 0x80060CFC is 0 between stretches and while a choice waits. A choice's answers are typed through the same buffer one by one, so only the last stays in memory: no choices here. Its question is also kept at 0x80061058. Read in a replay (docs/replay.md) at 42 moments, not yet on a device.

notes: In memory the script is plain Shift-JIS with CRLF line ends, a full-width yen sign and p at each page end, and a choice's answers as bare strings among its instructions. The stretch being shown is laid out into a buffer of 16-bit cells at 0x80061858 (the Shift-JIS code as a little-endian number, 0x0D0A for a line break, 0x0000 at the end), which the layout reads. u32 at 0x80060D00: 0 while text appears, 2 waiting at a line end, 3 waiting at a page end. Text is vertical, 13 characters to a column. While a choice's answers appear, the layout's message is the answer being typed.
